name: Amakano 3
source:
[b]In [u]Love[/u] With a Dream, Dreaming of [u]Love[/u]―[/b]

"I've come to get you."

One day, during my unremarkable life, a maid named "Scarlet Ikaruga Wisteria" comes to pick me up, also informing me that she is my grandmother's adopted daughter.

My grandmother owns a dormitory, but she is currently hospitalized due to poor health. Thus, she requests my help managing it for her.

In spite of my reservations about "Sasaura Dorm" being a girls' dormitory, I accept the task.

The kindhearted and popular classmate "Ootori Sayumi."
The [i]kouhai[/i], a cheerful and easy-going [i]gyaru[/i] "Yanagi Kanon."
Her older sister, "Yanagi Shion" who refuses to let the protagonist stay in the dormitory.

And lastly, the heiress of the Azarashi conglomerate "Goshoin Touka" that transferred in, who will have to work hard to adjust to life at the dorm.

Under one roof, their bonds gradually deepen, learning of the girls' dreams and true feelings.

With each carrying her own feelings, during the summer in an [i]onsen[/i] town, a coming-of-age story begins.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/amakano3/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
[b][u]Love[/u]怀着梦想，梦想着[u]Love[/u]―[/b]

“我是来接你的。”

有一天，在我平淡无奇的日子里，一位名叫“猩红斑鸠紫藤”的女仆来接我，还告诉我她是我祖母的养女。

我的祖母拥有一间宿舍，但她目前因健康状况不佳住院治疗。因此，她请求我帮助她管理这件事。

尽管我对“笹浦宿舍”是女生宿舍持保留态度，但我还是接受了这个任务。

善良、受欢迎的同学“大鸟纱由美”。
[i]kouhai[/i]，开朗、随和的[i]gyaru[/i]“柳花音”。
拒绝让主角留在宿舍的姐姐“柳紫苑”。

最后，转入的阿扎拉什集团“御书院董华”的女继承人，将不得不努力适应宿舍的生活。

在同一屋檐下，她们的感情逐渐加深，了解了女孩们的梦想和真实感受。

各怀心思，在[i]onsen[/i]小镇的夏天，展开了一段成长故事。
